title: Magical Quest Starring Mickey & Minnie
sources: RetroAchievements code notes, game 1100008679 (addresses via C2 ra_notes.py)
notes: Genre: Platformer. Live values from RA notes, not checked in a running game unless said. PC mGBA sweep (boot, mash, walk; C2 gbaverify): health 3/3 -> 2 -> 0, lives 2 -> 1 after a death. C3 generator (~/bdnight/c3work/gen). Companion idea: PokeDaisy (Lidor Itzhari).

widgets.text: A jump, B grab/throw blocks, R change costume.
widgets.label: Controls

widgets.text: Each costume (e.g. Magician, Fireman, Climber) gives a power; switch with R.
widgets.label: Costumes

widgets.text: Magician shoots magic (charge for more), Fireman puts out fire and melts ice blocks, Climber hooks onto ledges, and more per game.
widgets.label: Costumes

widgets.text: Grab blocks or enemies and throw them; charge attacks deal more damage. Pete is the recurring villain.
widgets.label: Tips

widgets.text: Stages through the Treetops, Dark Forest, Fire Grotto, Pete's Peak, Snowy Valley and Pete's Castle.
widgets.label: Structure

widgets.text: Coins buy health upgrades and items in shops.
widgets.label: Items
